# Seeker Store

Kotlin Android curation-layer MVP with optional verified APK install/update handoff and read-only Cloudflare catalog. Four tabs: Discover, DePIN, Endorsements, Agent. Ranking and identity signals are mocked; MWA, devnet transaction code, SQLCipher, P-256 signing and native offline Qwen are implemented. Consult README and evidence/STATUS.md for actual build versus device test results.

- README.md: product, setup and real-versus-mock table
- AGENTS.md: development constraints
- backend/README.md: catalog trust and deployment
- MODEL.md: pinned Qwen import
- evidence/STATUS.md: measured evidence
